auditor_mike: Quick follow-up for SOC2 binder: we need artifacts for the RBAC rollback on 2026-06-09 — PR, RBAC snapshot, KMS decrypt logs for the timeframe, and a signed handoff.

eng_ops: Hi @auditor_mike 1 — do you want the full k8s audit stream or just the change + rollback events?

sec_oncall: lean set: PR + sanitized audit snippets showing who patched/rolled back + KMS decrypt attempts (timestamps and key/envelope ids) + signed oncall handoff and timeline.csv.

eng_ops: collecting now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5271
Commit: 9b7d2c3
Rollback we ran:
`kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-serve --to-revision=42`

sec_oncall: sanitized k8s audit lines:
`2026-06-09T14:02:11Z svc-model-deploy patch rolebinding/model-service-read`
`2026-06-09T14:05:02Z samir patch rolebinding/model-service-read`
`2026-06-09T14:07:45Z maria-oncall rollback deployment/model-serve`

sec_oncall: KMS snippet:
`2026-06-09T14:06:00Z key=rdw-main action=AsymmetricDecrypt principal=svc-model-deploy status=OK env=env-3f2a`
`2026-06-09T14:06:07Z key=rdw-main action=AsymmetricDecrypt principal=devops-bot status=DENIED env=env-3f2b`
Rotation-id: rot-20260203-01

evidence-bot: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-214/{rbac_snapshot.json,kms_logs_snippet.txt,forensic_manifest.json,runbook_handoff.txt,timeline.csv,maria_signed_handoff.asc,evidence_mapping_SOC2_v1.pdf}

auditor_mike: good. please map files to controls: rbac_snapshot.json => CC6.*; kms_logs_snippet + manifest => CC7.*; runbook_handoff => CC4.*. Attach a 1-page mapping and a short narrative describing why rollback occurred and who approved.

eng_ops: mapping doc and narrative uploaded. timeline.csv includes links to PR and S3 artifacts. Logs sanitized to remove unrelated tokens; service accounts and key ids preserved.

auditor_mike: redaction looks fine. this closes follow-up A for now; we may request SIEM correlation later. thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
